name: hud_sensor_tracker_zar_mission_restore_callback
description: HudSensorTracker::ZarMission_RestoreCallback forwards ZAR Mission restore arguments to ApplyMissionDataAndReload and returns success. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation and disassembly at 0x417690 show forwarding reader, token, missionData, dataSize, and tracker user data into HudSensorTracker::ApplyMissionDataAndReload, then returning 1.
The direct callee HudSensorTracker::ApplyMissionDataAndReload is dependency-ready and functional-equivalent.
The native apply-mission-data smoke exercises the restore callback and verifies restored mission/objective state.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x417690 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
